body:
I was apparently  kick for excessive caps when as far as im concerned i did not! I'd had been in a game with YoungSkieth and he said he seen me use caps but didn't kick me straight away he taken a report first. Now though a investigation he did go take the report but why wouldn't he punish me on the spot? Now i was playing ,l hadent said a thing in chat then i kicked. I was very very confused and got a bit annoyed because i hadn't done so? -http://imgur.com/uwncOuy - Almost after this i told ElementProHD (My brother having being sat next to me to take as many screen shots as possible as far as chat goes up in chat heres the out come- http://imgur.com/a/OM1QI#yJF0ZU4 .so it appears i hadent used caps with in about 2/3 Mins. Now if you can see the times don't match up this a problem with the infractions how to the Minutes dont match we had investigated this and proved i hadent edited? Now Blizzem_ was in the game when i got got kicked and he said i hadent done anything wrong ,despite he could have been taking a report earlier. https://avicus.net/infractions?page=4 So heres where my infraction is and Blizzem did take give a punishment after this so.....
-I beilve this is link to the reason that me and him had a in a away a Argument that he did try to wind me up in a way

title: Appealing an infraction

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

We don't appeal kicks, especially not if the infraction is valid.
